identity.name: Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

land.text: the Mariana Islands District of the trust territory: 'the 14 northern islands of the Mariana Archipelago'

predecessors.note: The trust-territory dossier (this batch) records the loss to commonwealth-of-the-northern-mariana-islands on 3 November 1986. The page says Guam, 'the southernmost, ... is a separate U.S. territory'.

capitals.name: Saipan
capitals.note: Infobox: capital Saipan, '15°11′N 145°44′E'; the administrative centre is Capital Hill, 'a village in northwestern Saipan'.

correction.text: the fourteen northern islands of the Mariana archipelago, Guam excluded

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (no Cliopatria row): the country N. Mariana Is. is cells: 2 (about 506 km2) against the page's 464 km2 (infobox; the lead gives 475.26 km2 and the island table 463.63 km2).

ledger.note: 1986: the Northern Mariana Islands constitution becomes fully effective under the Covenant: 'on November 4, 1986, the Northern Mariana Islands constitution became fully effective under the Covenant' (another passage: implementation 'was completed on November 3, 1986'). The Covenant 'to establish a commonwealth in political union with the United States' was approved in a 1975 referendum and by Congress in 1976; a new government and constitution 'came into effect in part on January 9, 1978'.

certainty.note: Island coasts; Guam to the south is a separate territory.

sources.title: Northern Mariana Islands
sources.note: 1975 referendum, Covenant approved 1976, partial effect 9 (or 1) January 1978, full effect 3/4 November 1986, trusteeship end 22 December 1990, area 464 km2, fourteen islands, Saipan with coordinates, Guam excluded.

notes: Written by oc-02-x. One page opened (Northern Mariana Islands). The page disagrees with itself on dates: the Covenant's effect is given as 1 January 1978 in one passage and 9 January 1978 in another, and full effect as 3 November (completed) or 4 November 1986; the infobox lists 4 November 1986 as the end of UN trusteeship, while the text says the Trusteeship Council 'terminated the TTPI as it applied to the CNMI' on 22 December 1990. The dossier starts in November 1986 to match the trust-territory dossier; for 1978 to 1986 the land stays in the trust territory. The islands are a US dependency (type colony, family americas as the trust territory); united-states-of-america (am-07) should list it as a dependency. The page says in one sentence that Spain sold the Northern Marianas to Germany under the 1899 treaty and that after the First World War the League gave Japan a mandate over them (starting in 1918 on this page); the dossiers german-new-guinea and south-seas-mandate hold that period.
